resources.string: Information pursuant to § 5 DDG (German version is legally authoritative)

ParamWorker is a design tool. Check the dimensions, tolerances and strength of your parts yourself before manufacturing; the app is not intended for safety-critical components. Statutory liability for intent, gross negligence and injury to life, body or health remains unaffected.

ParamWorker has no servers of its own, no ads, no analytics or tracking tools and no user account. The app makes no internet connections. Your projects do not leave the device unless you export or share them. They are stored locally; depending on your system settings, Android may include them in a device backup. Feedback opens your email app.
“Send feedback” only opens your email app with a prepared message (app version, device, Android version); nothing is sent until you send it yourself.
